evidence_status: POST-RESULT ANALYTIC UPPER BOUND. Not preregistered, not a simulation rerun, not a measured frontier-model improvement.
optimistic_assumptions: Hold original readiness, owner consent, buyer beliefs, interests and fixed startup/acquisition/business/insurance costs fixed.
Serve every interested pool, including those originally withdrawn, unserved or lacking a ready supplier.
Charge the frozen $12000 fee, collect every amount, and incur zero repeat delivery, processing, failure or credit-loss cost.
This is more favorable than merely halving repeat inference tariffs or raising execution success to .98 under unchanged buyer beliefs.
fixed_volume_bound_derivation: Each original booking has at most $700 base inference cost times the declared retry cap2; halving tariffs saves at most $700 per original booking. This secondary bound holds volume fixed.
limitations: Changing buyer beliefs, readiness success/cost, qualified demand, allowed outputs or the offering requires a fresh evaluation.
These numerical values are conditional on the original hypothetical world model, not market measurements.
